description: This PHP source file defines the Arn class within the AWS SDK for PHP. The class provides functionality to parse, validate, and represent AWS Resource Names (ARNs), which are unique identifiers for AWS resources. It includes methods for parsing ARN strings, accessing their components, and converting them back to string form.

classes.name: Arn
classes.description: Represents and manipulates AWS ARN strings, providing parsing, validation, and component access functionalities.

methods.name: parse
methods.description: Static method that parses an ARN string into its component parts.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructor that initializes an Arn object from a string or array, validating its structure.

methods.name: __toString
methods.description: Converts the ARN object back into its string representation.

methods.name: getPartition
methods.description: Returns the partition component of the ARN.

methods.name: getService
methods.description: Returns the service component of the ARN.

methods.name: getRegion
methods.description: Returns the region component of the ARN.

methods.name: getAccountId
methods.description: Returns the account ID component of the ARN.

methods.name: getResource
methods.description: Returns the resource component of the ARN.

methods.name: toArray
methods.description: Returns the ARN components as an associative array.
